verdict.rationale: Ardent has no built-in natural-language interface. It supports NL operation indirectly: with the ardent-cli skill installed in a coding agent, 'a short ask is enough' and the skill works through setup. Agents like Claude Code and Cursor can also run the CLI themselves to create, use and delete branches. The CLI's JSON output, JSON errors and an llms.txt help agents drive it. This depends on an external agent plus the skill, and only setup is explicitly described as NL-driven. Missing for 10: a native first-party NL command interface, documentation of NL control beyond setup (e.g., branch management via plain-language asks), and independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works.
